description: Land Title Settlement Department  -   Maditthagama, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510016 and other declarations
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and owner details) by the Commissioner of Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
